pages.text: Die for real and a $(item)grave$() rises where you fell. It holds everything you carried: your inventory, armor, accessories, backpack and experience. Nothing is lost.$(br2)Chat tells you where it is, and you respawn with a compass that points to it. Right-click the grave to take it all back.
Only you can open your grave at first. After 15 minutes a friend can collect it for you, and you are told who did.$(br2)Being $(item)downed$() makes no grave: a grave only comes with a real death.
